entities.summary: The Kara class, Soviet designation Project 1134B Berkut B, was a class of guided missile cruisers built for the Soviet Navy between 1968 and 1976. NATO classified the type as cruisers mainly due to their size and the presence of the 'Metel' anti-ship missile system, capable of striking both submarines and surface vessels.
